job.title: Senior Enterprise Business Systems Engineer
job.description: We're hiring a Senior Enterprise Business Systems Engineer to develop, integrate, and optimize the platforms that power Nasuni's Go-to-Market operations. Salesforce is the core CRM. You'll work across Salesforce and a modern GTM technology ecosystem — including platforms like HubSpot, Workato, Fivetran, and Snowflake — to build solutions that are scalable, well-engineered, and ready for what comes next.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain scalable solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Salesforce Flow, Platform Events, and APIs
Collaborate with integration engineers to design and build connections between Salesforce and the broader GTM ecosystem
Support and develop integrations across a modern revenue technology stack including Salesforce, HubSpot, Fivetran, Workato, and Snowflake
Write and optimize SQL queries for data analysis, reporting validation, troubleshooting, and data quality investigations
Own technical delivery from design through deployment
Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate engineering while maintaining code quality and ownership
job.domain: Cloud Technology, CRM Development, Sales Operations

positioning: Prioritize bullets showing ownership, reliability, and cross-functional delivery impact.
project_suggestions: Highlight projects touching CI/CD, Service Cloud, CPQ
gap_analysis: Add quantified outcomes (latency, uptime, delivery speed, or cost savings) where possible.
